verdict.rationale: Data export is a fair question for a SaaS API gateway that holds user data such as usage history, activity logs and account settings, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a data-export feature or open export formats. The usage analytics (openrouter-docs-43) and the OpenAI-SDK drop-in compatibility (openrouter-docs-15) are adjacent features, not a way to export your data and leave.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
